# Logger counting

A custom Log handler turns three log operations into the value 3 by returning one from each operation.

- Supported engines: `env`, `oracle`, `compiled`
- Concepts: `effect-handlers`, `custom-effects`, `differential-testing`
- Refusal class: none

Canonical source: [`examples/logger-counting/main.bang`](https://github.com/phibkro/bang/blob/main/examples/logger-counting/main.bang)

```bang
effect Log { log : Int -> Int }

handle
  (logger.log(10)) + (logger.log(20)) + (logger.log(30))
with Log as logger {
  log(msg) => 1
}
```

Expected stdout:

```text
3
```
